## Summary

Architects and ships agentic pipelines on Claude, OpenAI models, and Gemini using
provider-native SDKs and custom MCP integrations, with runtime provider fallback,
retries, and per-run cost and latency tracking. Has shipped an evaluation layer with
LLM-as-judge scoring, golden datasets, regression suites that run on prompt or model
change, and tracing across multi-step runs. Built a generation-to-QA-to-publish
workflow for the Atlassian ecosystem that runs unattended at volume, with idempotency,
rate-limit handling, and failure isolation as first-class concerns. Delivered B2B
iGaming platform systems including a bonus engine, player account management, and
fraud detection, alongside Telegram Mini Apps and long-running Telegram bots in
production.

## Experience

### Spayon.io - Lead FinTech Engineer, Contract (Remote), Jan 2025 - Present
Lead engineer on a multi-currency payment gateway processing high-frequency
transactions for 100+ online merchants across Central Asia, Europe, and North
America, spanning payment, subscription, and wallet APIs, a multi-vendor admin
portal, and ARCA and MIR payment rail integrations.

- Financial Ledger Inspector: internal reconciliation tool comparing vendor wallet balances against a double-entry ledger in real time, flagging per-vendor discrepancies and exposing a full journal-entry audit trail.
- Metabase operations dashboard covering vendor liquidity, fee revenue by deposit and withdrawal, multi-currency gateway receipts, and reserve balances.
- PII handling: masking and tokenization of cardholder and merchant data across payment, subscription, and wallet APIs.

### CAIAT.US - Principal AI Product Engineer, Contract, June 2024 - Present
Delivery engineer across client AI platform engagements.

- Zetik: B2B iGaming and sportsbook platform, source-code licensed to operators. Bonus engine and abuse controls, player account management, sportsbook and in-house games, slot-provider integrations, affiliate campaigns, Fasttrack CRM, third-party fraud detection. Serving LATAM, Asia, Russia, and Middle East markets.
- AI-Native QA Pipeline (Atlassian ecosystem): automated quality-evaluation system for a 30-agent service desk scoring 200+ tickets per week, with a rubric-trained LLM-as-judge calibrated on human-scored samples, golden datasets, and regression suites re-run on every prompt and model change. Cut the feedback cycle from 6 days to 2, reached full coverage on high-priority tickets within 30 days, surfaced 7 knowledge-base articles. Published as an Atlassian community case study.
- Multi-Agent Content Pipeline (LegalCalls LLC): Whisper transcription, an LLM intake agent, three specialized agents generating in parallel, and output guardrails running brand-safety, fact-verification, and SEO checks before a human approval gate.
- Rev-Box: carrier data ETL platform for P&C insurance with idempotent ingestion, row-level error quarantine and retry, PII masking, and in-browser LLM mapping suggestions running with zero external API calls.
- MCP Server (Qlerify): Model Context Protocol server exposing product-modeling capabilities to LLM clients via native tool calling.
- Multi-provider orchestration across Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, and AWS Bedrock behind a routing layer with runtime fallback, with per-run spend and latency tracked through OpenRouter, CloudWatch, and Metabase.
- Local and fine-tuned model deployment with Ollama, HuggingFace, and Tinker.

### brandwise.ai (formerly 1hero.ai) - Founding AI Product Engineer (Remote), Aug 2023 - May 2024
Co-founded and architected an AI-powered customer support SaaS from zero. Python and
FastAPI backend handling ticket ingestion, LLM-based routing, and AI-drafted responses
via the OpenAI API with structured outputs, tool calling, and LangChain. Fine-tuned
GPT-3.5 on a proprietary dataset and implemented advanced RAG using Pinecone.

### Iabsis SARL - AI and Full-Stack Engineer, Web3 to AI Engineering (Remote), Jan 2023 - Mar 2026
- SerenGPT: agentic toolkit for job and candidate matching (CV generation, job matching engine, AI interview coach, AI recruiter analysis) orchestrated with LangGraph and the Google Agent Development Kit over Postgres with vector search, with LLM eval suites against scored test sets.

- Web3/DeFi: Airdrop.com, Alt.co, and Sezame Wallet, built with Ethers.js and Web3.js.

### TruckinDigital - Senior Full-Stack Web Engineer, Apr 2022 - Jul 2023
Trucking fleet management platform for US carriers built from scratch, with real-time
shipment tracking and fleet mapping via Trimble Maps, dispatcher-driver messaging over

### inKin Inc - Front-End Team Lead, Jun 2019 - Apr 2022
